tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Faintest navy wash: selected table rows, hovered nav groups.

tokens.usage: Navy for progress fills and chart secondary series.

tokens.usage: Mid navy: chart series and inactive stepper rails. Not for text.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Hover state of navy-700 actions.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL brand navy: #2E3792 as drawn in the logo and brand-board swatch; the brand board printed label says #13368D (unresolved, see README 3.1). Primary buttons, links, active states. White text on it: 10.1:1 light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary actions.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deep navy for dark panels and print headers.

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground. The darkest brand surface.

tokens.name: gold-50
tokens.usage: Gold wash behind Umrah highlights and premium notes.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Gold tint for badges.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Light gold: hairlines on navy, the sidebar tagline, emblem ring.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL brand gold: #FAB60D as drawn in the logo and swatch; the brand board printed label for this slot says #EFE9E1 (unresolved, see README 3.1). Vivid, so it is rationed: active nav marker, current step, Umrah tag, one highlight per screen. Text on it is on-accent (#1f1a0b), 9.7:1.

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Gold as TEXT: 5.6:1 on white, 12.6:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: PROVISIONAL Kaaba charcoal #3A3637 from the emblem; the brand board printed label for this slot says #E45A0B (unresolved, see README 3.1). Brand colour for print and the cover; not used for UI text.
